    • 字段详细资料

      • burstingEnabled

        @NameInMap(value="BurstingEnabled")
public Boolean burstingEnabled

        Specifies whether to enable the performance burst feature for disks that support this feature. Valid values:

        true: enables the feature. false: disables the feature. Note An error is returned if you specify any value for a disk that does not support the performance burst feature.

        example:

        false

      • deleteWithInstance

        @NameInMap(value="DeleteWithInstance")
public Boolean deleteWithInstance

        Specifies whether to release the disk when the instance is released. Default value: null. A value of null indicates that the current value remains unchanged.

        You cannot configure this parameter for cloud disks that have the multi-attach feature enabled.

        An error is returned if you set the DeleteWithInstance parameter to false in the following scenarios:

        The disk category is local disk (ephemeral). The disk category is basic cloud disk (cloud) and the disk is not detachable (Portable=false). Warning If you set this parameter to false and the ECS instance to which the disk is attached is locked for security reasons (the OperationLocks parameter indicates "LockReason" : "security"), the disk is released along with the instance regardless of the DeleteWithInstance setting when the instance is released.

        example:

        false

      • description

        @NameInMap(value="Description")
public String description

        The description of the disk. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

        example:

        test

      • diskId

        @NameInMap(value="DiskId")
public String diskId

        The ID of the disk whose attributes you want to modify.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        rcd-wz9c8isqly8637zw****

      • diskName

        @NameInMap(value="DiskName")
public String diskName

        The cloud disk name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters in the Letter category of Unicode, such as English letters, Chinese characters, and digits. It can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

        example:

        testDisk

      • regionId

        @NameInMap(value="RegionId")
public String regionId

        The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou
